title: Lesson 10 - Communication, training, and change management: running the plan under pressure
description: Prior to an implementation, assess user experience, communication plan, training, and change management, and establish metrics that measure success.

questions.question: The sponsor reports that logins are up but the business sees no improvement. Which measurement choice explains the gap?
options: Reporting vanity metrics such as logins instead of outcome metrics
Asking the sponsor to estimate the benefit
questions.explanation: Logins count presence rather than behavior or business result, so a report built on vanity metrics such as logins cannot show that anything improved.

questions.question: You have one Full sandbox, and integration and UAT both need it. Which sandbox should carry end-user training?
options: A Developer sandbox, because it refreshes daily
The Full Copy sandbox, shared with UAT
A Partial Copy sandbox, because it copies metadata plus template-sampled data with a 5 day refresh
questions.explanation: Partial Copy gives metadata and template-sampled data at 5 GB with a 5-day refresh, so it trains users on realistic records without consuming the single Full sandbox the other phases need.

questions.question: Four weeks after go-live, usage slips among the reps who were trained in week one. Which action is most likely to restore it?
options: Deploy in-app guidance prompts on the high friction pages
Send a reminder email to the whole sales team
Extend the original instructor-led course by another day
questions.explanation: In-app guidance prompts on the high friction pages put the instruction back on the page where the work happens, which addresses decayed training without another calendar-heavy session.
